name: Michael Kearney
reason: Title-screen medical role (owner, 12 Nov 2026): two web searches this run (12 Nov 2026) show him mainly as a palliative care physician (medical director of Cottage Health's Palliative Care Consultation Service, Santa Barbara; McGill and Noozhawk pages) whose books (Mortally Wounded, A Place of Healing, The Nest in the Stream) address care of the dying and the wounded healer, plus a nature novel, Becoming Forest. The only practice he leads that turned up was one past July 2024 nature-writing workshop co-led in West Cork; no own website, current classes, retreats or contact route were found, so there is too little spiritual work of his own to list. Possible owner's second look if a Becoming Forest project site with current offerings appears.
